question: Should the exact reviewed head roll out the new fail-closed authorization boundary for all authoritative repair apply and post-flight mutations now that the prerequisite is merged and required checks pass?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but automation cannot choose the operational tradeoff between stronger stale-write prevention and deliberate repair unavailability whenever target, review, check, receipt, or credential state cannot be proven current.

options.title: Approve coordinated rollout
options.body: Merge the exact reviewed head and monitor initial live repair runs for rejected or retryable blocked mutations without weakening the guards.

options.title: Hold for controlled soak
options.body: Keep the draft open and exercise representative apply and post-flight scenarios in a controlled environment before enabling the boundary on live repair runs.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated rollout
recommendation.body: Merge the exact reviewed head and monitor initial live repair runs for rejected or retryable blocked mutations without weakening the guards.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns both the merged review-activity prerequisite and the current mutation-boundary implementation, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the rollout decision.
